command:
set -eu
PKG=io.blueeye
EXPECTED_APP_SHA256=c7d86a56585bb9d2463498613ce356bb2d8bd57d4e6a29dccda9fea53bd8ee60
OUT=/tmp/tracker-phase2-device-acceptance
rm -rf "$OUT"; mkdir -p "$OUT/db-before" "$OUT/db-after"

git fetch origin main agent-control
git switch main
git merge --ff-only origin/main
echo REPO_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

adb start-server >/dev/null
# Give the phone a chance to accept the RSA authorization prompt.
i=0
while [ $i -lt 45 ]; do
  STATES=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && NF>=2 {print $1" "$2}')
  AUTH=$(printf '%s\n' "$STATES" | awk '$2=="device"{print $1}')
  COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$AUTH" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
  if [ "$COUNT" = "1" ]; then break; fi
  sleep 2
  i=$((i+1))
done
echo '=== ADB DEVICES ==='
adb devices -l
AUTH=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}')
COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$AUTH" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
if [ "$COUNT" != "1" ]; then echo DEVICE_GATE=FAIL_NOT_AUTHORIZED_OR_AMBIGUOUS; exit 31; fi
SERIAL=$(printf '%s\n' "$AUTH" | head -1)
adbx() { adb -s "$SERIAL" "$@"; }
echo SERIAL=$SERIAL
echo MODEL=$(adbx shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')
echo MANUFACTURER=$(adbx shell getprop ro.product.manufacturer | tr -d '\r')
echo ANDROID=$(adbx shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r')
echo SDK=$(adbx shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d '\r')

echo '=== PACKAGE / APK ==='
adbx shell pm path $PKG
if ! adbx shell pm path $PKG >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo PACKAGE_GATE=FAIL; exit 32; fi
adbx shell dumpsys package $PKG | grep -E 'versionName=|versionCode=|pkgFlags=|privateFlags=' | head -20 || true
APK_PATH=$(adbx shell pm path $PKG | tr -d '\r' | sed -n '1s/^package://p')
if [ -n "$APK_PATH" ]; then
  INSTALLED_SHA=$(adbx exec-out cat "$APK_PATH" | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')
  echo INSTALLED_APK_SHA256=$INSTALLED_SHA
  echo EXPECTED_PHASE2_APK_SHA256=$EXPECTED_APP_SHA256
fi

echo '=== RUN-AS / PERMISSIONS ==='
if adbx shell run-as $PKG id >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo RUN_AS=PASS; else echo RUN_AS=FAIL; exit 33; fi
for P in android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS; do
  adbx shell pm grant $PKG $P >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
done
adbx shell dumpsys package $PKG | grep -E 'BLUETOOTH_SCAN|BLUETOOTH_CONNECT|ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION|ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION|POST_NOTIFICATIONS' || true

snapshot_db() {
  dest=$1
  mkdir -p "$dest"
  list=$(adbx shell run-as $PKG ls -1 databases 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true)
  echo "DB_FILES[$dest]"; printf '%s\n' "$list"
  [ -n "$list" ] || return 0
  printf '%s\n' "$list" | while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
    adbx exec-out run-as $PKG cat "databases/$f" > "$dest/$f" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$dest/$f"
  done
}
inspect_db() {
  python3 - "$1" <<'PY'
import os,sqlite3,sys,json
d=sys.argv[1]; found=0
for f in sorted(os.listdir(d)):
    if f.endswith(('-wal','-shm','-journal')): continue
    p=os.path.join(d,f)
    if not os.path.isfile(p): continue
    try:
        c=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{p}?mode=ro',uri=True)
        integ=c.execute('pragma integrity_check').fetchone()[0]
        tables=[r[0] for r in c.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table' and name not like 'sqlite_%' order by name")]
        counts={}
        for t in tables:
            try: counts[t]=c.execute('select count(*) from "'+t.replace('\"','\"\"')+'"').fetchone()[0]
            except Exception as e: counts[t]='ERR:'+str(e)
        print('DB_INSPECT',json.dumps({'file':f,'integrity':integ,'tables':counts},sort_keys=True))
        c.close(); found+=1
    except Exception: pass
if not found: print('DB_INSPECT no_sqlite_database_detected')
PY
}

# Consistent pre-test DB snapshot; force-stop does not delete app data.
adbx shell am force-stop $PKG
sleep 1
snapshot_db "$OUT/db-before"
inspect_db "$OUT/db-before" | tee "$OUT/db-before.txt"

adbx logcat -c
adbx shell am start -W -n $PKG/.MainActivity | tee "$OUT/launch.txt"
sleep 3
# Locate the Compose Scan button once; top-bar position is stable across lifecycle toggles.
adbx shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/blueeye-window.xml >/dev/null 2>&1
adbx exec-out cat /sdcard/blueeye-window.xml > "$OUT/window.xml"
XY=$(python3 - "$OUT/window.xml" <<'PY'
import re,sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
root=ET.parse(sys.argv[1]).getroot()
for n in root.iter('node'):
    if n.attrib.get('content-desc')=='Scan':
        m=re.match(r'\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]',n.attrib.get('bounds',''))
        if m:
            x1,y1,x2,y2=map(int,m.groups()); print((x1+x2)//2,(y1+y2)//2); break
PY
)
if [ -z "$XY" ]; then echo UI_SCAN_BUTTON=NOT_FOUND; exit 34; fi
SCAN_X=$(printf '%s' "$XY" | awk '{print $1}'); SCAN_Y=$(printf '%s' "$XY" | awk '{print $2}')
tap_scan() { adbx shell input tap "$SCAN_X" "$SCAN_Y" >/dev/null; }
echo SCAN_BUTTON_XY=$SCAN_X,$SCAN_Y

# Initial start.
tap_scan; sleep 6
adbx logcat -d -v threadtime | grep -E 'ScannerService|BleScanner|AndroidRuntime|FATAL EXCEPTION|SecurityException' | tail -300 > "$OUT/log-initial.txt" || true
PID=$(adbx shell pidof $PKG | tr -d '\r' || true)
SERVICE=$(adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG | grep -c 'ScannerService' || true)
RUNNING=$(grep -c 'lifecycle=RUNNING' "$OUT/log-initial.txt" || true)
echo INITIAL_PID=$PID INITIAL_SERVICE_MATCHES=$SERVICE INITIAL_RUNNING_EVENTS=$RUNNING
if [ -z "$PID" ] || [ "$SERVICE" -lt 1 ] || [ "$RUNNING" -lt 1 ]; then echo INITIAL_SCAN_GATE=FAIL; exit 35; fi
echo INITIAL_SCAN_GATE=PASS

# 20 real UI stop/start cycles.
echo '=== START STOP x20 ==='
i=1
while [ $i -le 20 ]; do
  tap_scan; sleep 0.7
  tap_scan; sleep 1.3
  echo CYCLE_$i=DONE
  i=$((i+1))
done
sleep 3
adbx logcat -d -v threadtime | grep -E 'ScannerService|BleScanner|AndroidRuntime|FATAL EXCEPTION|SecurityException' | tail -1800 > "$OUT/log-cycles.txt" || true
python3 - "$OUT/log-cycles.txt" <<'PY'
import re,sys,collections
s=open(sys.argv[1],errors='ignore').read(); c=collections.Counter(re.findall(r'lifecycle=([A-Z_]+)',s))
print('CYCLE_LIFECYCLE_COUNTS',dict(sorted(c.items())))
print('CYCLE_FATAL_COUNT',s.count('FATAL EXCEPTION')); print('CYCLE_SECURITY_EXCEPTION_COUNT',s.count('SecurityException'))
if s.count('FATAL EXCEPTION') or s.count('SecurityException'): raise SystemExit(41)
PY
SERVICE=$(adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG | grep -c 'ScannerService' || true)
[ "$SERVICE" -ge 1 ] || { echo CYCLE_GATE=FAIL_SERVICE_NOT_RUNNING; exit 42; }
echo CYCLE_GATE=PASS

# Background/foreground must not restart scanner.
START0=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'lifecycle=START_REQUESTED' || true)
RUN0=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'lifecycle=RUNNING' || true)
adbx shell input keyevent KEYCODE_HOME; sleep 5
PID_BG=$(adbx shell pidof $PKG | tr -d '\r' || true)
SERVICE_BG=$(adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG | grep -c 'ScannerService' || true)
adbx shell am start -W -n $PKG/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 3
START1=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'lifecycle=START_REQUESTED' || true)
RUN1=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'lifecycle=RUNNING' || true)
echo BG_PID=$PID_BG BG_SERVICE=$SERVICE_BG START=$START0/$START1 RUNNING=$RUN0/$RUN1
if [ -z "$PID_BG" ] || [ "$SERVICE_BG" -lt 1 ] || [ "$START0" != "$START1" ] || [ "$RUN0" != "$RUN1" ]; then echo BACKGROUND_GATE=FAIL; exit 43; fi
echo BACKGROUND_GATE=PASS

# Bluetooth OFF/ON.
echo '=== BLUETOOTH OFF ON ==='
BT_TOGGLE=PASS
if ! adbx shell svc bluetooth disable >/dev/null 2>&1; then BT_TOGGLE=UNSUPPORTED; fi
if [ "$BT_TOGGLE" = PASS ]; then
  sleep 7
  OFF_EVENT=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'lifecycle=BLUETOOTH_OFF' || true)
  SERVICE_OFF=$(adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG | grep -c 'ScannerService' || true)
  echo BT_OFF_EVENT=$OFF_EVENT BT_OFF_SERVICE=$SERVICE_OFF
  adbx shell svc bluetooth enable >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  sleep 8
  SERVICE_ON=$(adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG | grep -c 'ScannerService' || true)
  echo BT_ON_SERVICE_BEFORE_EXPLICIT=$SERVICE_ON
  if [ "$OFF_EVENT" -lt 1 ] || [ "$SERVICE_ON" -gt 0 ]; then echo BLUETOOTH_GATE=FAIL; exit 44; fi
  adbx shell am start -W -n $PKG/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 2
  tap_scan; sleep 6
  SERVICE_RESTART=$(adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG | grep -c 'ScannerService' || true)
  [ "$SERVICE_RESTART" -ge 1 ] || { echo BLUETOOTH_GATE=FAIL_EXPLICIT_RESTART; exit 45; }
  echo BLUETOOTH_GATE=PASS
else
  echo BLUETOOTH_GATE=SKIP_ADB_TOGGLE_UNSUPPORTED
fi

# Force-stop/relaunch: no automatic scanner until explicit Start.
echo '=== PROCESS RECREATION ==='
adbx shell am force-stop $PKG; sleep 3
PID_STOP=$(adbx shell pidof $PKG | tr -d '\r' || true)
SERVICE_STOP=$(adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG | grep -c 'ScannerService' || true)
echo FORCE_STOP_PID="$PID_STOP" FORCE_STOP_SERVICE=$SERVICE_STOP
if [ -n "$PID_STOP" ] || [ "$SERVICE_STOP" -gt 0 ]; then echo PROCESS_GATE=FAIL_STOP; exit 46; fi
adbx shell am start -W -n $PKG/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 4
SERVICE_RELAUNCH=$(adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG | grep -c 'ScannerService' || true)
echo RELAUNCH_SERVICE_BEFORE_EXPLICIT=$SERVICE_RELAUNCH
if [ "$SERVICE_RELAUNCH" -gt 0 ]; then echo PROCESS_GATE=FAIL_AUTO_RESTART; exit 47; fi
tap_scan; sleep 6
SERVICE_RESTART=$(adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG | grep -c 'ScannerService' || true)
[ "$SERVICE_RESTART" -ge 1 ] || { echo PROCESS_GATE=FAIL_EXPLICIT_RESTART; exit 48; }
echo PROCESS_GATE=PASS

# Snapshot DB after lifecycle stress.
adbx shell am force-stop $PKG; sleep 1
snapshot_db "$OUT/db-after"
inspect_db "$OUT/db-after" | tee "$OUT/db-after.txt"
python3 - "$OUT/db-before" "$OUT/db-after" <<'PY'
import os,sqlite3,sys,json
def stats(d):
 out={}
 for f in os.listdir(d):
  if f.endswith(('-wal','-shm','-journal')): continue
  p=os.path.join(d,f)
  try:
   c=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{p}?mode=ro',uri=True); integ=c.execute('pragma integrity_check').fetchone()[0]
   tables=[r[0] for r in c.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table' and name not like 'sqlite_%'")]
   out[f]={'integrity':integ,'counts':{t:c.execute('select count(*) from "'+t.replace('\"','\"\"')+'"').fetchone()[0] for t in tables}}; c.close()
  except Exception: pass
 return out
print('DB_BEFORE',json.dumps(stats(sys.argv[1]),sort_keys=True)); print('DB_AFTER',json.dumps(stats(sys.argv[2]),sort_keys=True))
PY

# Restart scanner, then screen sleep/wake as final test so a secure keyguard cannot block later UI automation.
adbx shell am start -W -n $PKG/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 2
tap_scan; sleep 6
START0=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'lifecycle=START_REQUESTED' || true)
RUN0=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'lifecycle=RUNNING' || true)
PID0=$(adbx shell pidof $PKG | tr -d '\r' || true)
adbx shell input keyevent KEYCODE_SLEEP; sleep 8
PID_SLEEP=$(adbx shell pidof $PKG | tr -d '\r' || true)
SERVICE_SLEEP=$(adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG | grep -c 'ScannerService' || true)
adbx shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP; sleep 4
START1=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'lifecycle=START_REQUESTED' || true)
RUN1=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'lifecycle=RUNNING' || true)
echo SCREEN_PID=$PID0/$PID_SLEEP SCREEN_SERVICE=$SERVICE_SLEEP START=$START0/$START1 RUNNING=$RUN0/$RUN1
if [ -z "$PID_SLEEP" ] || [ "$SERVICE_SLEEP" -lt 1 ] || [ "$START0" != "$START1" ] || [ "$RUN0" != "$RUN1" ]; then echo SCREEN_GATE=FAIL; exit 49; fi
echo SCREEN_GATE=PASS

adbx logcat -d -v threadtime | grep -E 'ScannerService|BleScanner|AndroidRuntime|FATAL EXCEPTION|ANR in io.blueeye|SecurityException' | tail -2500 > "$OUT/final-log.txt" || true
python3 - "$OUT/final-log.txt" <<'PY'
import re,sys,collections
s=open(sys.argv[1],errors='ignore').read(); c=collections.Counter(re.findall(r'lifecycle=([A-Z_]+)',s))
print('FINAL_LIFECYCLE_COUNTS',dict(sorted(c.items())))
print('FINAL_FATAL_COUNT',s.count('FATAL EXCEPTION')); print('FINAL_ANR_COUNT',s.count('ANR in io.blueeye')); print('FINAL_SECURITY_EXCEPTION_COUNT',s.count('SecurityException'))
if s.count('FATAL EXCEPTION') or s.count('ANR in io.blueeye') or s.count('SecurityException'): raise SystemExit(61)
PY
echo REPORT_DIR=$OUT
echo PHASE2_DEVICE_FLOW=PASS
